official_volumes.note: per scored state, from the pinned MetricEvaluator call of the lesion metric (same connectivity, same spacing): fpv_official_ml = volume of predicted components overlapping no reference component, fnv_official_ml = volume of reference components no predicted component overlaps (calc_fpv_fnv, threshold 0); None where the official value is NaN (no reference component); the six-state tables' fp_ml / fn_ml are voxel-wise and keep their names

line.rule: passed = d5 >= line (petct_sirb_executor.at_or_above) and no failed trajectory; d5 = equal-weight mean over the patients with a GT-positive scan of their round-5 Dice (frozen style per scan)

statistics.interval_note: patient bootstrap percentile interval, registered draws and seed; descriptive (SAP section 11)
